item.title: Version 0.26.20
item.description:
이번 업데이트

버그 수정

  • 일부 사용자에게서 앱이 정상적으로 열리지 않던 문제를 해결했어요.

What's new

  • Google Calendar integration
    Connect your calendar to bring meetings into BizCrush automatically.
  • Slack automations
    Send meeting tags and workflows straight to Slack channels.
  • External mic support
    Pick a specific channel on multi-input interfaces like Scarlett 2i2.
  • Clearer meeting audio
    Improved on-device noise reduction makes voices easier to hear.
  • Smoother live transcript
    Interim captions stay stable and edits no longer flicker back.

Bug fixes

  • Fixed an issue where the app couldn't open its database for some Mac users
  • Live transcript edits now save reliably
  • Integration status now shows a proper loading state
  • Empty context source summaries no longer cause hiccups
